# 765. Couples Holding Hands

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
# DFS
class Solution(object):
    def minSwapsCouples(self, row):
        """
        :type row: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        n = len(row)
        g = collections.defaultdict(list)
        for i in range(n / 2):
            v1 = row[i * 2] // 2
            v2 = row[i * 2 + 1] // 2
            if v1 != v2:
                g[v1].append(v2)
                g[v2].append(v1)
        vis = [0 for _ in range(n / 2)]
        ans = 0
        for i in range(n / 2):
            if not vis[i]:
                q = [i]
                vis[i] = 1
                cnt = 0
                while q:
                    cur_node = q.pop()
                    cnt += 1
                    for new_node in g[cur_node]:
                        if not vis[new_node]:
                            vis[new_node] = 1
                            q.append(new_node)
                ans += cnt - 1
        return ans
```
